## `POST /auth/bootstrap/complete`

### Request Body

- Required: `true`
- Content types: `application/json`

### Request Examples

- Content type: `application/json`

```json

  "bootstrap_token": "example",
  "password": "example",
  "principal_name": "example",
  "username": "example"
}
```

| --- | --- |
